title: Hyperbolicity of one-relator groups without Baumslag–Solitar subgroups
exact_target: For finite X and any $r\in F(X)$, is $\langle X|r\rangle $ word-hyperbolic whenever it contains no subgroup isomorphic to BS(m,n) for any nonzero integers m,n?
